#What Can Kimi Do:

- Kimi K3.1 Pro:  Major upgrades to 3D creation, coding, writing and financial analysis.

- 3D Game Creation: Animate your ideas with Kimi game maker —generate multiplayer 3D games complete with characters, levels, and combat systems. Polish visuals and gameplay through conversation.

- 3D Modeling: Describe an object, building, or scene in text, and bring it to life as a detailed 3D model. Refine through conversation until it matches your vision.

- Agent Swarm: Put multi-agent systems to work on complex projects. Kimi coordinates up to 300 AI agents across 4,000 parallel steps, bringing research, analysis, and report writing together in one workflow.

- AI Slides: Turn any topic or visual reference into a professional PowerPoint presentation. Let Kimi transform your ideas into designer-quality layouts tailored to your work and study.

- Office Agent: Convert between PDF, Word, Excel and PowerPoint files with ease: PDF to Word, Word to PDF, and PDF to Excel. Generate Excel formulas and turn data into charts. Summarize, translate, and comment across files.

- Vibe Coding: Describe your ideal website or share a visual reference. Kimi refines layouts, animations, and interactive features through conversation, turning your idea into a functional website with professional code.

- Plugins: Connect to authoritative data sources like Wind and S&P. Conduct analyses using professional data you can trust.

- Remote Control: Control your computer from your phone — pick up unfinished tasks wherever you are.

- Sync Across Devices: Your conversations, files, and work progress stay in sync across devices in real time.

- Paid Memberships: Upgrade to unlock 4× high-speed access to our latest flagship models (up to 28× credits & 1M-token context). Supercharge your workflow with Agent Swarm multi-tasking, Kimi Code (CLI/IDE/Desktop), 3D Make (3D modeling), multiple featured plugins, Deep Research, one-click website deployment, a 24/7 Kimi Claw cloud sandbox, and up to 50GB project storage.
